title: Yoga in the Treatment of Adolescent Idiopathic and Degenerative Scoliosis
brief_summary: The effect of two isometric exercises is measured on Cobb angles from films taken 4-10 months apart.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Scoliosis
* Willingness to do pose at least once daily for 4 -10 months
* Willingness to have a second X-ray 4-10 months after starting to do pose

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neuromuscular disease
* Previous Spinal surgery
* Pregnancy
